text: Place an old key under your pillow for three nights, and pay attention to what begins to open in your life. This is not superstition. The key is one of the oldest symbols of opening that exist.

Take an old key, one that no longer opens any door. The older, the better. It carries history, and time strengthens the symbol. Hold it with both hands before sleep, and say silently: may this key open the paths that are closed.
May what is mine find me without obstacles. Place it under your pillow, and sleep. On the first night, pay attention to your dreams. Many people dream of doors, and roads that did not exist before.

On the second night, notice how you feel when you wake. There may be a new clarity. On the third night, release all expectations. Simply sleep, and trust. If doors are not opening, my friend, sometimes it is because something inside you keeps them shut.
The fear you carry locks doors. Rituals unlock them. What keeps them open is the work you do within. Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
